content:
maria: Heads up — after the CU12 base image rollout this morning a subset of GPU nodes in us-west2 started failing container start with RTLD symbol errors.
ashok: seeing the same on canaries, containers crash during libnvidia init. quick log snippet:```\nmarius@node:~$ docker logs model-server\nmodel-server: error while loading shared libraries: /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libcuda.so: undefined symbol: cuInit\n```\nzach: also hit `undefined symbol: cuDeviceGetAttribute` and mixed messages about GLIBCXX_3.4.29 vs 3.4.30 — smells like mismatched libstdc++ from a rebuild with gcc13.
simone: did the image builder change the base distro or compiler flags? we should rollback that image.
infra-bot: CI: image-builder/ci pipeline 4287 completed at 1746336000 (base gcc13, glibc 2.35) :information_source:
maria: yes the infra/image-builder moved to debian-bookworm + gcc13 to satisfy cu12 toolchain. We rebuilt ~120 images and pushed the tag `redwood/runtime:cu12-20240410` at 1746335000.
nashok: nodes with older driver (515.x) can't resolve new symbols from cu12 libs. NCCL init sometimes works but then fails at collective setup with `ncclInternalError: unrecognized symbol`.
zach: impact: ~18% of GPU pods in us-west2 failed startup and autoscaler tried to spin up replacements in us-east1 where capacity is tight — ended up provisioning on higher-cost nodes. Cost spike in last 2hrs ~ +27% for GPU spend. :grimacing:
simone: action plan? my vote: 1) revert runtime tag to cu11-compatible image, 2) drain affected nodes, 3) pin the image-builder pipeline to use gcc12 for now.
maria: agree. I've queued a rollback to `redwood/runtime:stable-202403` and started a rolling deploy to the node pool. Running `kubectl rollout status ds/gpu-runtime -n infra`.
olivia: note: some teams rely on the cu12-only features (memory prefetch) — we need a compatibility note and a canary plan for next attempt.
nashok: also discovered RTLD_LOCAL vs RTLD_GLOBAL differences in our start script. When both system libcuda and image-bundled libcuda load, symbol collisions occur. Short-term we can force `LD_PRELOAD=/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libcuda.so` in the pod spec to prefer host driver libs.
nashok: snippet to test on a failing node:```\nkubectl exec -it pbgp-123 --namespace=ml -- /bin/bash\nLD_PRELOAD=/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libcuda.so ./model-server --debug\n```\nmaria: good idea. I tested LD_PRELOAD on two canaries and services came up. pushing a patch to nodepool DaemonSet to set preload for now.
zach: be careful — LD_PRELOAD ties us to host driver compatibility. Long-term we should: 1) standardize gcc/toolkit used for image builds, 2) add an image validation step that checks symbol compat against minimum driver on fleet, 3) add per-region canary gating.
simone: I'll open a ticket with infra/infra-issuetracker and add acceptance tests: `symbol-compat-check` that runs `nm -D`/`objdump -T` and matches expected symbols.
infra-bot: Incident created: #INC-2024-341 — CU12 image rollover caused RTLD collisions and regional capacity fallout. Assigned to: maria, ashok, simone.
maria: timeline: rolled rollback at 1746339200, draining 6 nodes, replaced with stable image. early signs are good, failures down from 18% -> 2%. will monitor for 2h.
olivia: FYI customers on Dedicated may have seen transient 503s; CS alerted. please add a postmortem once stable. :eyes:
zach: postmortem checklist: what changed in image-builder, list of images rebuilt, driver ABIs per region, cost delta, and mitigation timeline. I'll draft it after we confirm stable.
nashok: quick note: for the future, add a cluster-level admission controller that rejects images with libcuda in image unless explicitly annotated. That would have blocked this.
simone: agreed. Also let's add a capacity fallback policy to prefer same-region premium nodes before cross-region provisioning to avoid cost spikes.
maria: monitoring: we're adding a short-term alert for `gpu_pod_start_failure_rate > 5%` per region and a cost anomaly alert for GPU node hourly spend.
buildbot: Deploy job 5912: rollback `redwood/runtime:stable-202403` -> completed successfully at 1746339400 :white_check_mark:
maria: will keep thread updated. thanks everyone for quick responses. next steps: finalize postmortem, schedule controlled CU12 re-rollout with canary gating, and add symbol compatibility test to CI. :rocket:
